Corollary
[$L^2$ uniqueness] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0076 ↗ prop:chow-ii-weighted-l2 1. ch10:10.70\group Weak heat solutions

For $\xi =0$, the weighted energy is nonincreasing; zero initial $L^2$ norm forces $u\equiv 0$.
Proof

\sketch Apply the proposition with $\xi =0$ and use nonnegativity of the integrand.

□
